Scenario TC-11/S28 — Timeline windows come from the retention config, not hard-coded values

Requirements it checks:
- U12: Retention windows are configuration values, not hard-coded (so they can be lengthened under a hospital affiliation); the Hospital timeline window follows from them.
- U3: Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only, per the retention rules.

Given: Main's code and UAT 3.6 ('All windows are configuration values, not hard-coded'; 'Course timeline … therefore show today and yesterday only')
When: Read where the Hospital timeline window comes from (isRecentCourseLine in src/domain/courseTimeline.ts: today's and yesterday's labels) and the Nursing Home visit count (SHOW_LAST = 3 in src/features/snf/patient/panels/CoursePanel.tsx), and compare with the retention config (HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts)
Then: Both display windows derive from configured values, so lengthening retention under a hospital affiliation lengthens what the timeline shows
Oracle: Doc review by a developer, every finding quoted with file and line. A window that does not read the config is a finding against 3.6; it becomes a Fail or a pass once Q15 says whether the derived display must follow the config

THE ORACLE WINS. The question below only scopes this scenario to what code can decide. If the question, or its pass/fail rule, ever reads differently from the Then/Oracle above, follow the Then/Oracle, give the verdict the oracle gives, and say where they differ in openQuestions.

Open questions the oracle defers to, with the oracle's default for each (do not settle them yourself):
- pending:Q15 — oracle: "it becomes a Fail or a pass once Q15 says whether the derived display must follow the config". Default: a display window that does not read the config is reported as a finding pending Q15, not as a Fail

Gaps the matrix already records (use the id in a label only when the finding is exactly that gap):
- (none)

YOUR QUESTION (answer this, from the code):
Do the Hospital timeline display window (isRecentCourseLine in src/domain/courseTimeline.ts: today and yesterday) and the Nursing Home visit count (SHOW_LAST in src/features/snf/patient/panels/CoursePanel.tsx) read or derive from the retention config (HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts), so that lengthening retention lengthens what the timeline shows?

pass = both display windows read or are computed from the retention config values
fail = a display window has its own value, not derived from the config. Per the oracle this is a finding against 3.6 that becomes a Fail or a pass only once Q15 is answered: label it pending:Q15

Other halves of this scenario that another lane or a person runs (do not judge them; if the code you read predicts one of them, report that as a finding labelled half:<name>, supports = pass or fail):
- (none)

Not part of this verdict (other scenarios, or notes that decide nothing here):
- (none)



Label every finding:
- new: a failing point the matrix does not already record (supports = fail)
- known:<id>: exactly one of the recorded gaps listed above
- pending:<id>: a failing point whose verdict the oracle hands to one of the open questions above
- half:<name>: a point about one of the other halves above
- context: background, not for or against the verdict

Answer with: verdict (pass | fail | pending | unsure), answer (a short paragraph a QA lead can read: what the code does and why that is the verdict; name the recorded gaps and open questions it touches), findings (each with claim, file, line, quote, supports = pass | fail | context, label), physicianImpact, openQuestions, notDecidableByCode.
